claim_boundary: This plan separates locally executable contract tests from physical Ubuntu OS acceptance. Passing fake-device, injected-adapter, native Windows, or Ubuntu WSL tests cannot satisfy a numbered procedure that requires signed media, physical boot, destructive storage, encryption recovery, kernel enforcement, or two A1 boards.

development_lanes.purpose: Cross-platform deterministic contract and concurrency tests
Strict Linux/POSIX contract tests and non-destructive platform preparation

contract_tranche.local_disposition: typed boundary, trust-adapter, replay, and negative contract tests

mandatory_physical_evidence: offline installation and recovery on both E1 and E2
Secure Boot and UKI tamper rejection
dm-verity A/B update and three-attempt fallback under power interruption
LUKS2 recovery credential exercise independent of inference
100 suspend/resume cycles and 1,000 compact lifecycle cycles
enforcing cgroup v2, AppArmor, seccomp, device, pinned-memory, and generated-code isolation
complete vertical workflow from distributed media with missing-model, worker-crash, and failed-artifact-commit cases
severity_rule: Any unauthorized effect, secret disclosure, committed-data corruption, privilege escape, unrecoverable supported boot, host OOM, post-cancellation effect, or invalid resource reuse blocks the affected release.
formal_exit_rule: G2 may pass only after T01-T16 and the complete vertical workflow pass on both physical A1 boards and every mandatory failure case preserves authorization and acknowledged content.
